title: Factorized PathNet path × Mirror role address on unseen combinations
hypothesis: A learned three-entry role codebook over a shared four-path PathNet module graph will generalize to four path-role pairs withheld from meta-training, achieving at most 0.65x the held-out query RMSE of PathNet path-only while using no more than 1.25x its actual payload bytes; rank-2 and additive role controls, independent held-out task fits, and direct native Givens conditioning test value and attribution.
physical_object: two shared four-dimensional linear modules per each of two PathNet layers
mirror_coordinate: a learned two-angle code per role identity, factorized independently from the two-layer path identity and composed at inference
logical_multiplicity: 12 possible path × role functions; 8 pairs observed in training, 4 unseen pairs evaluated
controls: PathNet path-only without a role coordinate
factorized rank-2 additive basis × role codebook

task.type: 4D linear regression with two module choices per layer and three fixed role orientations; target is a Givens rotation of the selected teacher module sum; noise sigma=0.02

development.selection_metric: query RMSE averaged over four withheld path-role pairs

gates.PROMISING: Both dev seeds: Mirror held-out RMSE <=0.65x path-only; Mirror actual payload <=1.25x path-only and <= independent fit bytes; end-to-end query time <=1.25x rank-2 control; Mirror beats full role-vector table RMSE by >=10% at <= its bytes; direct native Givens is not output/payload equivalent.
gates.FAIL: Either seed misses a success gate, or native Givens exactly matches the codebook map/payload, or held-out path-role RMSE fails the quality threshold.
gates.NOT ESTABLISHED: Independent least-squares query RMSE exceeds 0.08 on both worlds, or serialized output replay fails.

boundaries: Synthetic aligned factorization test only; no full PathNet/Routing Network, neural or natural-task claim.
Every path and every role appears in training, but the four listed path-role pairs do not.
Native Givens is a direct implementation of the tested View and is required for attribution.
Fresh seeds remain sealed unless all development gates pass.
